summary: Raw size-versus-age series exist per species in Add-my-Pet (tL/tW data sets inside each entry) and in scattered Dryad datasets (e.g. Tribolium larval growth); FishBase holds only fitted von Bertalanffy parameters, WHO gives smoothed human centiles to age 5, and TRY has no trajectories. No single repository dataset spans several lineages through to the late phase of mass loss.
next_step: Harvest tW/tL data sets from a sample of Add-my-Pet entries across phyla (the mydata .m files), add WHO/NHANES-type human series extended into adulthood, then pre-register a model comparison (autocatalytic velocity curve vs logistic, Gompertz, von Bertalanffy, spline).
obstacles_confirmed: Available databases often store fitted parameters rather than raw time series (FishBase PopGrowth confirmed).
Public trajectories often stop before the late loss of mass (WHO 0–5 y; AmP series end at adult size).
